relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, we show that some responses are affected by applying the TRPV1 agonist capsaicin.

key_findings: A CMOS high-density microelectrode array with PDMS microchannels records stimulation-induced responses of individual hiPSC-derived sensory axons.
Axons show diverse response profiles classifiable into functional archetypes, and some are affected by capsaicin.
